scope: Twelve current SSO/directory/account/session/idempotency/policy/challenge/provenance/signup models. Read-only tenant FK, uniqueness, binding and protocol constraints. Expiry/nonce/version consumption also relies on the server transaction checks. orgMemberId is application-checked, not a database FK. Signup consent migration included. No claim of original login-policy/external institution acceptance.

constraints.name: Account_ssoProviderId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("ssoProviderId") REFERENCES "SsoProvider"(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Account_sso_provider_match
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("left"("providerId", 4) = 'sso:'::text) AND ("ssoProviderId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("providerId" = ('sso:'::text || "ssoProviderId"))) OR (("left"("providerId", 4) <> 'sso:'::text) AND ("ssoProviderId" IS NULL))))

constraints.name: Account_userId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: IdempotencyRecord_invalidation_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("invalidatedAt" IS NULL) AND ("responseCipher" IS NOT NULL) AND ("requestHash" IS NOT NULL)) OR (("invalidatedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("responseCipher" IS NULL) AND ("requestHash" IS NULL))))

constraints.name: OrgEmailChallenge_tenantId_stateId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "stateId") REFERENCES "SsoState"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: Session_activeCompanyId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("activeCompanyId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: Session_userId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SsoLoginPolicy_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: SsoPolicyChallenge_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SsoPolicyChallenge_userId_sessionId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId", "sessionId") REFERENCES "Session"("userId", id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SsoProvider_saml_cert_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((protocol <> 'saml'::text) OR (("idpCert" IS NOT NULL) AND ("idpCert" ~~ '%BEGIN CERTIFICATE%'::text))))

constraints.name: SsoProvider_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: SsoProvider_urls_https
constraints.definition: CHECK (((protocol = ANY (ARRAY['gpki'::text, 'saeol'::text, 'groupware'::text])) OR ((("authorizationUrl" ~~ 'https://%'::text) OR ("authorizationUrl" ~ '^http://(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost|\[::1\])[:/]'::text)) AND (POSITION(('@'::text) IN ("authorizationUrl")) = 0) AND ((protocol = 'saml'::text) OR (("tokenUrl" IS NOT NULL) AND (("tokenUrl" ~~ 'https://%'::text) OR ("tokenUrl" ~ '^http://(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost|\[::1\])[:/]'::text)) AND (POSITION(('@'::text) IN ("tokenUrl")) = 0) AND ("jwksUrl" IS NOT NULL) AND (("jwksUrl" ~~ 'https://%'::text) OR ("jwksUrl" ~ '^http://(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost|\[::1\])[:/]'::text)) AND (POSITION(('@'::text) IN ("jwksUrl")) = 0))))))

constraints.name: SsoSessionProof_providerId_accountId_userId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("providerId", "accountId", "userId") REFERENCES "Account"("ssoProviderId", id, "userId") ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SsoSessionProof_tenantId_providerId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "providerId") REFERENCES "SsoProvider"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SsoSessionProof_userId_sessionId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId", "sessionId") REFERENCES "Session"("userId", id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SsoSignupAcceptance_userId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SsoSignupIntent_tenantId_providerId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "providerId") REFERENCES "SsoProvider"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SsoState_binding_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("providerVersion" >= 0) AND (("providerVersion" = 0) OR (((mode = 'link'::text) AND ("userId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("sessionId" IS NOT NULL)) OR ((mode <> 'link'::text) AND ("userId" IS NULL) AND ("sessionId" IS NULL))))))

constraints.name: SsoState_invitation_binding_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("invitationVersion" IS NULL) AND ("invitationTokenHash" IS NULL)) OR ((mode = 'invite'::text) AND ("invitationId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("invitationVersion" IS NOT NULL) AND ("invitationVersion" > 0) AND ("invitationTokenHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("invitationTokenHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))))

constraints.name: SsoState_tenantId_providerId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "providerId") REFERENCES "SsoProvider"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SsoState_userId_sessionId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId", "sessionId") REFERENCES "Session"("userId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: VirtualOrgMember_tenantId_providerId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "providerId") REFERENCES "SsoProvider"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.name: Account_derive_sso_provider
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "Account_derive_sso_provider" BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF "providerId", "ssoProviderId" ON public."Account" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION derive_account_sso_provider()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.derive_account_sso_provider()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  NEW."ssoProviderId" := CASE WHEN left(NEW."providerId",4)='sso:' THEN substring(NEW."providerId" from 5) ELSE NULL END;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

triggers.name: Account_password_history
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "Account_password_history" AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF password ON public."Account" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION record_credential_change()

triggers.name: session_active_account_guard

triggers.name: sso_session_proof_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER sso_session_proof_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON public."SsoSessionProof" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sso_session_proof_immutable()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sso_session_proof_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SSO session authentication evidence cannot be rewritten' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END;
$function$
